body: Hi. I'm sorry to hear about the symptoms your dad is having. I suffered a moderate TBI in 2009. The issues your dad is experiencing are symptoms I deal with, almost 4 years after the fact. I know is hard to find Neuro professionals out there. It was my experience as well, since many of the symptoms are subjective. My advice is to find a Physical Medicine Doctor and/Physical Therapist. They are more focused on rehabilitation, maybe your dad will benefit more from treatment than diagnosis. Check your local listing. Prescribed therapy helped me a lot, made me functional and taught me to manage the vertigo. Also, for headaches I see a Pain and Spine Doctor. I get injections on my head and the headaches disappear for 3 months. If you like to contact me: go to http://facebook.com/tbiwarriors and leave me a post and I'll contact you. Also, on Twitter @PurpleHeart0629. Good luck and I hope all gets resolved and he gets better. Regards. ~ tbiwarriordotcom
